M340 cluster prototype

Drag each dot up or down until it sits on its tick. Blue dots are speed (mph), red dots are RPM (× 1000). Copy the result below.

To feed it real data, call cluster.update({engine: true, speed: 62, rpm: 3.1, mode: "SPORT PLUS", sel: "M", gear: 4, map: true, fuel: 0.75, oil: 220, range: 312, temp: 32.0, time: "2:44 pm"}) from whatever reads your car’s CAN or OBD data. The map here is a made-up stand-in for the Waze picture.
